longTitle.officialTitle: To amend title XII of the Public Health Service Act to expand the definition of trauma to include thermal, electrical, chemical, radioactive, and other extrinsic agents.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Improving Trauma Care Act of 2014”.

subsection.heading: Revised Definition Under Trauma Systems Grants Programs.—
subsection.content:
Paragraph (4) of section 1231 of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-31) is amended to read as follows:
“(4) Trauma.—The term ‘trauma’ means an injury resulting from exposure to—
“(A) a mechanical force; or
“(B) another extrinsic agent, including an extrinsic agent that is thermal, electrical, chemical, or radioactive.”
.

subsection.heading: Revised Definition Under Interagency Program for Trauma Research.—
subsection.content:
Paragraph (3) of section 1261(h) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-61(h)) is amended to read as follows:
“(3) The term ‘trauma’ means an injury resulting from exposure to—
“(A) a mechanical force; or
“(B) another extrinsic agent, including an extrinsic agent that is thermal, electrical, chemical, or radioactive.”
.
